title: Messier: A High-Resolution Corpus for Cross-Benchmark Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2607.25891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Comprehensively evaluating AI agents across interactive environments is difficult due to fragmented tasks, scaffolds, verifiers, and scoring rules. Unfortunately, existing efforts to unify these evaluations are limited in scale and domain, making costly reruns necessary and leaving available data incomparable. We introduce MESSIER, a unified corpus of 957,611 records spanning 30 benchmarks, 745 agents, 11,891 tasks, and 74,263 verifiers. MESSIER combines public evaluation results with new runs on six underrepresented professional and scientific benchmarks, standardizing their heterogeneous components into a common schema. Using this corpus, we show that frontier progress is uneven across benchmark groups, with function-calling evaluations largely saturated, programming improving fastest, and enterprise workflows remaining most challenging. translated_title: Messier：用于跨基准智能体评估的高分辨率语料库
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.25891v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：由于任务、脚手架、验证器和评分规则各自碎片化，在交互式环境中全面评估AI智能体十分困难。遗憾的是，现有的统一评估工作在规模和领域上都较为有限，导致需要付出高昂代价进行重复运行，并使已有数据之间无法相互比较。我们推出了MESSIER，这是一个包含957,611条记录的统一语料库，涵盖30个基准、745个智能体、11,891个任务和74,263个验证器。MESSIER将公开的评估结果与在六个代表性不足的专业和科学基准上新增的运行结果相结合，将其异构组件标准化为统一的数据模式。利用该语料库，我们发现前沿进展在各基准组之间并不均衡：函数调用类评估已基本饱和，编程类任务提升最快，而企业工作流仍然最具挑战性。反事实重评分进一步表明，在多验证器任务中采用严格的全通过评分可能会……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MESSIER是一个统一了30个基准、745个智能体、超95万条评估记录的高分辨率语料库，通过将异构评估组件标准化为统一模式实现跨基准的智能体评估，并揭示出前沿进展不均衡：函数调用已饱和、编程提升最快、企业工作流仍最具挑战。
en_tdlr: MESSIER is a high-resolution unified corpus of over 950,000 evaluation records spanning 30 benchmarks and 745 agents that standardizes heterogeneous evaluation components for cross-benchmark agent evaluation, revealing uneven frontier progress: function-calling is largely saturated, programming improves fastest, and enterprise workflows remain the most challenging.
